name: Albersdorf (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green in the proportions 1:5:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Albersdorf (a megalithic tomb, an ear of wheat and a sword on green).
history: Municipal flag of Albersdorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Albersdorf arms — megalithic tomb, ear and sword on green
